Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the accommodation of housing and employment growth under local comprehensive plans.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to accommodating housing and employment growth forlocal jurisdictions planning under RCW 36.70A.040; and adding a newsection to chapter 36.70A RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 36.70A RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Local jurisdictions that are required or choose to plan under RCW36.70A.040 shall ensure that no reduction in their capacity toaccommodate projected housing and employment growth occurs as a resultof amendments to their comprehensive plans and/or developmentregulations.
